reviews.text: Two Zero Eight is such a great salon and spa! Laura is so sweet and does an amazing job with my hair each time! I am always completely satisfied and in love with my hair every single time! I 100% recommend Laura and the entire salon!

Everyone here does such a great job. I go to Kayla and she is amazing! I always get highlights and she makes them look so natural and blended. My hair always grows out so beautifully. She is also great with detail cuts!

Looking for a fabulous spa salon experience? Two Zero Eight is the place you've been looking for! TZE has an outstanding team and a delightful location. Every visit I've had at this salon has been wonderful and relaxing.
